I thoroughly enjoyed all 3 games and can't see what the fuss is about concerning the endings. My Shepard chose synthesis, as this embodied his play style throughout; preserve life whenever possible. I do admit to snuffing out Oleg in the Citadel DLC since he pissed me off big time. Having played Cyberpunk 2077 I am OK with the Protagonist not making it in the end. Definitely worth a NG+ run.

So far from what I have seen in game is the graphics.
The graphics are fantastic,
The voice acting is flawless and spot on,

The visuals are remarkable and stunningly beautiful.
The controls for both keyboard, mouse and gamepad are smooth and not janky nor clunky at all.

Mass Effect Legendary Edition is a blast from the past with a fresh coat of paint! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the galaxy as Commander Shepard, with updated graphics, smoother gameplay, and improved mechanics that'll leave you itching for more.

The story follows Shepard's heroic mission to save the galaxy from the menacing threat of the Reapers, a race of sentient machines determined to destroy all organic life. You'll be faced with choices that'll impact the outcome of the story, making every playthrough a unique experience. The characters are unforgettable, with rich and well-written stories that'll have you emotionally invested in their fates.

Combat has been ramped up with tighter controls and more responsive aiming, making the action-packed battles even more intense. Customize Shepard's abilities to your playstyle with the extensive skill tree, and get ready to take on the galaxy in style. The updated graphics give the game a modern look, while still retaining the classic style that fans have come to love.

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure with a remastered classic that will leave you breathless!

I've already played this game for over 500 hours on my Xbox copy. Since I've moved to PC I don't know if I'll play it as much now but I've already downloaded tons of mods. There are some mod lists out there for new players but I don't recommend downloading any as you should get the vanilla experience before downloading any drastic changes. In fact, I recommend that you stop reading reviews now and just buy the game as it's one of the most fleshed-out and character-driven franchises in Sci-fi. Beware though that once you finish the trilogy you're likely to not find anything else quite like Mass Effect and you'll come back for another play-through like the rest of us. As you've likely heard, the endings to Mass Effect 3 might not satisfy you, but the current state of things is a lot better than it used to be. You can also mod the various games in the trilogy to better suit your tastes, but again, I recommend only downloading mods until after your first play-through.

Thanks for reading this, and I hope you enjoy Mass Effect like I and so many others have.

One of the best RPG trilogies ever. Played this when I was a kid and it blew my mind. When I replay games I played then, they usually can't compete with youth. It almost never grabs me as much as it did in those days. 

Mass Effect, however, has only gotten better over the years. The characters are even better, the decisions are tougher to mull over, the set pieces are bigger, and Shepard is an even better avatar for the player. This is still one of the only RPGs that actually benefits from a voiced player-character rather than keeping them silent.

These are the closest we will probably ever get to the perfect Star Trek RPG in our heads. I need more RPGs where I command a starship confronting moral dilemmas on a planetary/galactic scale with a bunch of branching outcomes. If anyone can do it, Larian can.
